offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures generic prescription tablets and capsules, including immediate-release and extended-release formulations. It sells finished medicines to drug wholesalers and pharmacy chains and supplies products to pharmaceutical marketing partners.

primary_products.value: generic ADHD medicines; opioid dependence treatments; prescription weight-management medicines; prescription pain medicines

primary_services.value: contract manufacturing of oral prescription drugs

customer_segment.value: B2B: drug wholesalers, pharmacy chains and pharmaceutical marketing partners

end_markets.value: ADHD treatment; addiction treatment; weight management; pain management

revenue_model.value: product sales: finished generic prescription tablets and capsules; licensing or royalties: rights to market selected generic medicines; project or contract: manufacturing finished medicines for pharmaceutical companies
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: formulates active ingredients and excipients into finished medicines for wholesalers, pharmacy chains and pharmaceutical companies

geography_served.value: US national: U.S. prescription drug market, with manufacturing in Northvale, New Jersey

specialization.value: niche specialist: generic oral solid-dose drugs in immediate-release and extended-release formulations

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: pharmaceutical wholesalers supplying pharmacies; direct sales: pharmacy chains and wholesale accounts; partners / resellers: pharmaceutical companies marketing selected products under commercial agreements
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval and manufacturing standards for generic drugs, plus DEA registration and controls for scheduled medicines

notes: The current scope of licensing and contract manufacturing arrangements is uncertain.
